contracts.name: Floating Dancer
contracts.printedText: If Floating Dancer wins the confrontation, you gain 5 points for each manifestation in your Interzone.
contracts.printedParagraph: If Floating Dancer wins the confrontation, you gain 5 points for each manifestation in your Interzone.

contracts.name: Plea for Generosity
contracts.printedText: Gain 5 points for each non-token manifestation in the Confrontation Zone under the control of a target player.
contracts.printedParagraph: Gain 5 points for each non-token manifestation in the Confrontation Zone under the control of a target player.

contracts.name: Agrupol, Ponderer of Fields
contracts.printedText:
When Agrupol wins a confrontation, you gain 5 points for each manifestation of which you are the owner in each Empathic Vessel.
If Agrupol is put at the bottom of the deck, shuffle it.
contracts.printedParagraph: When Agrupol wins a confrontation, you gain 5 points for each manifestation of which you are the owner in each Empathic Vessel.

contracts.name: Donmo, the Truth-Bender
contracts.printedText:
Cannot be used as tribute.
As long as Donmo is in the Interzone, you may Exhaust it: Restore one target Exhausted card for each Temperament, other than Donmo.
As long as Donmo is on the field, at the end of the turn each opponent gains 5 Points for each Exhausted card under your control.
contracts.printedParagraph: As long as Donmo is on the field, at the end of the turn each opponent gains 5 Points for each Exhausted card under your control.

contracts.name: Lombriculpop
contracts.printedText: When Lombriculpop wins a confrontation, you gain 5 Points for each point of excess difference between Lombriculpop's power and that of the First Manifestation controlled by a target opponent.
contracts.printedParagraph: When Lombriculpop wins a confrontation, you gain 5 Points for each point of excess difference between Lombriculpop's power and that of the First Manifestation controlled by a target opponent.

contracts.name: Armored Pachywyrm
contracts.printedText: If Armored Pachywyrm wins the confrontation, a target opponent loses 5 points for each point of excess difference between Armored Pachywyrm's power and that of the First Manifestation controlled by that player.
contracts.printedParagraph: If Armored Pachywyrm wins the confrontation, a target opponent loses 5 points for each point of excess difference between Armored Pachywyrm's power and that of the First Manifestation controlled by that player.
